summary: Phase 3 frontend retest of the LiveMap _leaflet_pos crash fix. Logged in as admin.test-fleet@quickwing.com, navigated to /test-fleet/bookings, and executed all 5 acceptance flows: (1) opened Live Map tab — map renders, stats correctly show '2 moving / 0 idle / 0 offline', no console error; (2) immediately switched to Fleet Board — no crash overlay; (3) rapidly cycled Fleet Board <-> Live Map <-> All Cars Calendar 5 times — no crash; (4) clicked a fleet-live-<carId> button on the Fleet Board — view switched to Live Map and map centered on that vehicle (zoomed from Ireland-wide to Cork area, focused pin visible) with no console error; (5) switched away from map after focus — no crash. Console captured 0 (zero) '_leaflet_pos' errors across all flows. The FitBounds fix (map.whenReady() + {animate:false} + try/catch + cancel flag on unmount) fully resolves the react-leaflet crash reported in iteration_32.
critical_code_review_comments: One unrelated React DOM warning is still logged once: 'Received `%s` for a non-boolean attribute `%s`' (jsx=true). This is styled-jsx / a component passing `jsx={true}` on a native <style> or DOM node. Not from LiveMap and not blocking, but worth cleaning up.

The Marker data-testid quirk from iteration_32 is still present (as agreed, not being fixed this iteration). If per-pin selectors become required, attach via markerRef and marker.getElement().setAttribute after mount.
LiveMap.js FitBounds fix is clean: map.whenReady() + {animate:false} + try/catch + cancelled flag. Good pattern.
